instruction.text: Match the verb with the noun it becomes when adding the suffix 'ation'.

hint.text:
When adding the suffix 'ation' to a verb, it becomes a noun. Sometimes the root word changes before the suffix is added.
Words with the suffix 'ation' usually tell an action, a process or a result.
